corrections.finding: Left navigation rail was too narrow and semantically simplified.
Top shell was compressed into a single command row.
corrections.change: Add global nav plus contextual dashboard command hierarchy.

corrections.finding: First pass authored four KPI cards instead of five.
corrections.change: Add Assets Processed and Worker Health; remove Storage from KPI row.

corrections.finding: Recent Projects was stacked below Recent Activity.
corrections.change: Use three parallel lower content columns.

corrections.finding: Console and footer branding were collapsed together.
corrections.change: Split bottom region into console/resource strip plus branded footer.

corrections.finding: Inspector lacked preview and detailed project metadata.
corrections.change: Add semantic preview placeholder and richer metadata.

forgeLimitations.finding: Production-density XAML made the flat Visual Tree difficult to navigate.
forgeLimitations.response: Added Visual Tree filtering and Named only mode.

forgeLimitations.finding: Benchmark XAML revisions should not require rebuilding Forge or Workshop for every visual iteration.
forgeLimitations.response: Added direct Open/Reload/Save XAML workflow and live repository benchmark loading.

guidanceChanges: Infer repeated KPI cardinality before authoring.
Treat major vertical/column boundaries as structural evidence, not cosmetic spacing.
Preserve separate global navigation and contextual command layers when both are visible.

secondPass.summary: Major screen architecture now aligns substantially better in the 50% overlay; remaining differences are mainly asset/icon fidelity, typography, spacing, and smaller geometry tuning.
